newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products end lower on drop in soybeans.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products end lower on drop in soybeans.

text.p: CBOT soy product futures closed lower on a sharp drop in soybean futures, traders said.
Good crop weather in the U.S. Midwest and a bearish USDA quarterly stocks report combined to hit prices, they said.
Fund selling led the way down with an estimated 2,500 sold in soymeal and at least 4,000 sold in soyoil, traders said.
Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 35,000 contracts, up from 27,113 Friday, according to the CBOT. Soyoil futures volume was estimated by USDA at 32,000 contracts, up from 26,592 Friday.
Soyoil closed 0.25 to 0.68 cent per lb lower, with October down 0.59 at 23.86 cents. Soymeal was $2.70 to $7.90 per ton lower, with October down $7.90 at $254.50 per ton.
